card.name: Endings of long words in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: The last piece of a long medical word written in ALL CAPS, such as AMYLOID, PENICILLIN, ANEMIA or HYPERSENSITIVITY, inside boxed warnings or warning text.

modes.label: Word endings in caps
modes.description: Final piece of a capitalized drug or condition name in a warning.
modes.example: REACTIONS HAVE BEEN REPORTED IN PATIENTS ON PENICILL<<IN>> THERAPY.

modes.label: Boxed warning titles
modes.description: Middle or end of a capitalized word in a boxed warning headline.
modes.example: WARNING: AMYLO<<ID>> RELATED IMAGING ABNORMALITIES See full

card.writes: It seems to favor tokens starting with capital CO or GR, which fits continuing in capitals.
card.plain: It fires near the end of long medical words typed in capital letters in warning sections.
